children: The promoter family of Dr Azad Moopen has increased its stake in Aster DM Quality Care Ltd, buying shares worth about Rs.350 crore from a TPG-backed investor.

Union (Mauritius) Holdings Ltd, owned by Dr Azad Moopen and his family, acquired 46.09 lakh shares, or around 0.57 percent of the company's equity capital, from Centella Mauritius Holdings Ltd on September 2. The shares were purchased at Rs 760 apiece for Rs 350.34 crore.

Following the transaction, the Moopen family's holding in Aster DM Quality Care has risen to about 24.58 percent, strengthening promoter ownership in one of India's largest integrated healthcare platforms.

The stake purchase comes months after the merger of Aster DM Healthcare and Quality Care India, which brought together the Aster, CARE Hospitals, Evercare and KIMSHEALTH brands under a single entity. The combined platform now operates 39 hospitals in 28 cities with over 10,890 beds, giving it a significant presence in south and central India.

The company said the transaction reflects the promoter family's confidence in the merged entity's ability to create sustainable long-term value and capitalise on growth opportunities in India's healthcare sector.

title: Moopen family raises stake in Aster DM, buys share worth Rs 350 crore
